7abad0df3b0cc794.description: Sponsorship Integration Manager | Gaming, Esports & Live Events Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia / Remote with required travel Contract: 14 months, with potential 3-month extension Experience: Minimum 8 years Sector: Gaming, Esports, Festivals & Live Entertainment About the Opportunity We are recruiting an experienced Sponsorship Integration Manager to support a major international gaming and esports festival programme in Saudi Arabia. This is an exciting opportunity for a sponsorship activation professional with proven experience transforming brand sponsorship commitments into engaging, fully operational live-event experiences. The successful candidate will play a key role in coordinating sponsor activations, managing deliverables and ensuring sponsorship activities are successfully integrated into the wider festival programme. This is a hands-on sponsorship activation and integration role , rather than a sponsorship sales or business development position. Key Responsibilities Act as the main coordination point for the delivery and integration of assigned sponsorship activation programmes. Translate sponsor entitlements into engaging, practical activation concepts aligned with festival objectives. Develop detailed activation plans covering audience engagement, space requirements, visitor throughput, staffing and operational delivery. Coordinate sponsor deliverables, approval processes, timelines and outstanding requirements. Ensure all activations comply with brand guidelines, event layouts and operational constraints. Work closely with event planning, creative, production and operational teams to integrate sponsorship activities. Coordinate sponsor branding, space allocation and technical or build requirements through the appropriate project teams. Manage changes to sponsorship activation plans and resolve delivery challenges. Maintain accurate activation schedules, progress trackers and stakeholder updates. Essential Requirements Minimum 8 years' relevant experience in sponsorship activation planning or integration for large-scale live events, gaming, esports or festivals. Proven experience delivering at least two live event seasons . Demonstrated hands-on experience personally developing and delivering sponsorship activations. Strong understanding of sponsorship entitlements, brand activation requirements and event integration. Experience planning activation layouts, staffing, audience flow and operational requirements. Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, timelines, approvals and deliverables. Strong organisational, problem-solving and project coordination skills. Professional English communication skills. Desirable Experience Experience delivering sponsorship activations for major international or global brands. Background in major esports tournaments, gaming festivals, sporting events or large-scale entertainment programmes. Experience coordinating multiple sponsor activations within complex event environments. Previous experience working in Saudi Arabia or the GCC. Arabic language skills. Working Arrangements Two potential working arrangements are available: Riyadh-based: Working from the project office, with relocation and visa support subject to agreed terms. Remote-based: Working Sunday to Thursday on Riyadh business hours, with required travel to Saudi Arabia. All candidates must be available onsite in Riyadh during the required festival operating periods in July–August and November 2027. This is a full-time, fixed-term opportunity requiring dedicated involvement throughout the engagement. How to Apply If you have a strong background in sponsorship activation, brand experiences and major live-event delivery, we would like to hear from you. Please apply with your updated CV and details of sponsorship activations or major events you have personally delivered. Join a major international gaming and entertainment programme in Saudi Arabia.

The project site is approximately 200 km north-east of Taif, towards Riyadh, and about 26 km south of Al Mouwayh, a town on the Jeddah-Riyadh highway. This full-time position involves reviewing mobilisation records, identifying compliance gaps, maintaining audit data, and producing reports. Benefits Bechtel offers a robust benefits package designed to support employee well-being and career advancement. Further details on total rewards and benefits can be found on the Bechtel Total Rewards page.

7a07697af83c8d6a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث فرع شركة افلاك للصناعات الإلكترونية عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتنفيذ السياسات التسويقية للسلع والخدمات، بالإضافة إلى تقييم فعاليتها وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة. الهدف من الوظيفة يهدف أخصائي التسويق إلى تحديد الأهداف التسويقية، وتطوير الاستراتيجيات والخطط اللازمة لتحقيقها، مع الإشراف على تنفيذها وتقييم النتائج. يشمل ذلك إجراء اختبارات السوق وتحليل أداء المنتجات لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد الأهداف التسويقية العامة والفرعية، وتطوير السياسات والخطط والبرامج التسويقية. تحليل دورة حياة المنتج وتحديد عوامل نجاح أو فشل تسويق المنتجات. تحليل أسعار المنافسين وتطوير سياسات تسعير تنافسية. تحديد برامج الترويج واختيار قنوات التوزيع وتقييم فعالية الحملات الإعلانية. وضع جداول زمنية لتنفيذ السياسات التسويقية ومتابعة الإجراءات وتقييم النتائج. إجراء اختبارات للمنتجات الجديدة قبل طرحها في الأسواق باستخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتسويق، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التسويق. القدرة على تحديد الأهداف وتطوير السياسات التسويقية. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم أداء المنتجات والسوق. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيتم العمل ضمن فريق متخصص في فرع شركة افلاك للصناعات الإلكترونية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

7a97aff5ab3a52aa.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إبكار المحدودة عن مندوب مشتريات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى إدارة عمليات الشراء المختلفة، بدءًا من تحديد الاحتياجات وحتى استلام المواد ومطابقة المواصفات، مع ضمان الالتزام باللوائح التنظيمية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طلبات الشراء الواردة من الجهات المعنية وتدقيقها لضمان توافقها مع اللوائح التنظيمية للمشتريات. تنفيذ عمليات الشراء المباشر للمواد والسلع المختلفة وفقًا للوائح والإجراءات المعتمدة. إعداد وتجهيز وثائق المناقصات، وتوزيعها على الموردين المحتملين، وجمع عروض التوريد. تشكيل فرق لدراسة وتحليل العروض المقدمة، ومتابعة عملية الدراسة، وتدقيق النتائج لضمان اختيار العرض الأنسب. إرساء طلبات الشراء على العروض الفائزة بما يتوافق مع اللوائح والتنظيمات المعمول بها. متابعة استلام المشتريات، والتحقق من مطابقة الكميات والمواصفات المطلوبة. تدقيق المطالبات المالية المتعلقة بالمشتريات لضمان صحتها ودقتها. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيق وحفظ جميع المستندات والسجلات المتعلقة بالمشتريات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المشتريات أو ما يعادله. القدرة على فهم وتطبيق اللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بعمليات الشراء. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات جيدة في التفاوض والتواصل. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في تدقيق المستندات والمطالبات. القدرة على إعداد التقارير المهنية. مهارات تنظيمية لإدارة المهام المتعددة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق عمل شركة إبكار المحدودة في جدة، مكة المكرمة. ستتاح للموظف فرصة للعمل في بيئة ديناميكية تدعم النمو المهني. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة للانضمام إلى فريقنا.

7a44ad7d2c5e1e6e.description: About Deloitte Deloitte is one of the largest professional services firms globally, recognized for its impact and commitment to clients, people, and society. The Role: Consultant Senior Manager, Cyber Operate Cybersecurity Compliance Specialist This full-time position is for a Consultant Senior Manager specializing in Cyber Operate Cybersecurity Compliance, based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. 7a312a282ef22ac3.description: About the Role AlKhalejiah is seeking an experienced Cost Control Manager to lead and enhance the costing function for its food manufacturing operations in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. 7a4628d2866094d6.description: The Director, Security Command & Integration provides strategic and operational leadership for the integration of security command, control, communications, intelligence, technology, incident coordination and commercial delivery across QIC Security Operations. The role is accountable for ensuring the District Security Operations Centre (DSOC) operates as the central hub for situational awareness, operational coordination, information management and escalation, and that security contracts and commercial arrangements provide compliant, effective and value-driven services aligned with operational demand. The role holder connects people, processes, technology, data and contracted services into a single operating model that supports daily security operations, major events, emergencies, elevated security postures and the transition from development to steady-state city operations. Security Strategy and Transformation Own the development and periodic review of the long-term strategy, target operating model and capability roadmap, aligning command, integration, resilience and service priorities with Qiddiya growth and the transition to steady-state city operations. Define the future balance of employed, contracted and specialist capability, ensuring workforce structures and sourcing models remain scalable, resilient, commercially sustainable and aligned with forecast operational demand. Security Command, Control & DSOC Operations Define and maintain the integrated security command, control and coordination model, including roles, decision rights, escalation routes, command levels and interfaces with operational teams. Provide executive oversight of the DSOC operating model, staffing, procedures, shift governance, briefings, logs, incident coordination and operational reporting. Ensure timely collection, validation, analysis and dissemination of security information from personnel, systems, assets, contractors and external stakeholders. Direct integrated coordination for significant incidents, events and elevated security postures, ensuring clear command, tasking, communication and decision logging. Systems, Technology & Operational Integration Lead the operational integration of CCTV, access control, alarms, communications, incident management, analytics and other security technologies into DSOC workflows. Establish readiness, maintenance, resilience, fallback and recovery requirements for command-and-control technologies and communications. Incident, Crisis & Major Event Readiness Maintain command structures, duty arrangements, contact protocols, incident rooms and supporting documentation for routine and exceptional operations. Coordinate the command, communications, reporting and contractor interfaces required for major events, VIP/VVIP activity and heightened security postures. Plan and oversee table-top and live exercises that test DSOC, communications, escalation, continuity and cross-functional coordination. Contracts, Commercial & Supplier Governance Establish and oversee governance for security contracts, including performance cadence, KPI/SLA assurance, change control, risk, compliance and executive reporting. Own the strategic commercial framework for outsourced security services, ensuring delivery models remain scalable, cost-effective and aligned to future city operational requirements. Direct performance reviews, non-conformance management, recovery plans and escalation for persistent or high-risk supplier failure. Bachelor’s Degree essential, Master’s Degree preferred Recognized qualification in Security Management, Risk Management, Emergency Management, Business, Operations, - -- Technology or a related discipline. ASIS CPP, CSMP or equivalent senior security certification preferred. Formal senior-level training or evidenced professional competence in incident command, crisis management or security command-and-control operations. Demonstrable commercial and contract-management competence relevant to outsourced security services. Valid driving licence accepted for on-site driving in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Extensive leadership experience in security operations, command and control, security systems integration, incident management or a closely related environment. Proven accountability for an operational security control room, command centre, SOC/GSOC/DSOC or comparable multi-system coordination environment. Demonstrated experience leading or supporting command arrangements for serious incidents, major events, emergencies and elevated threat conditions. Strong operational understanding of CCTV, access control, alarms, communications, incident management platforms and system resilience. Substantial experience governing complex outsourced security services, including KPIs, SLAs, change control, invoice assurance, claims, performance recovery and value-for-money challenge. Experience designing, mobilising and improving integrated operating models, procedures, governance and management information. Proven ability to advise executives, influence cross-functional leaders and manage complex internal, contractor and external stakeholder interfaces.

7a153fbd2ede6c01.description: We are looking for a motivated and technically solid L1 Data Engineer to join our growing Data & Analytics team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the data architecture and infrastructure that supports our organization's data strategy. You will work hands-on to develop, test, and deploy reliable data solutions — ensuring pipelines are scalable, efficient, and aligned with business requirements. This is an ideal opportunity for a data professional who is eager to deepen their expertise in cloud-native data platforms, particularly within the Microsoft Azure and Databricks ecosystem, and who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES • Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT workflows to support business intelligence and analytics use cases. • Build and optimize data ingestion processes using Azure Data Factory and Databricks, ensuring data quality and consistency across all layers of the data platform. • Transform and process large datasets using PySpark and Python, applying best practices for performance and maintainability. • Write and optimize complex SQL queries to support analytical reporting and data validation requirements. • Collaborate with data architects and senior engineers to implement and maintain data models aligned with organizational standards. • Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve pipeline failures and data quality issues, applying root-cause analysis to prevent recurrence. • Contribute to documentation of data pipelines, data dictionaries, and engineering standards. • Support the team in exploring and evaluating new tools and approaches to continuously improve the data infrastructure. 3+ years of professional experience in a Data Engineering or closely related role. Strong proficiency in Python for data processing, transformation, and automation tasks. Hands-on experience with Pandas for data manipulation and PySpark for distributed data processing. Practical experience with Databricks, including notebook development, clusters, and job orchestration. Experience building and managing data pipelines with Azure Data Factory. Working knowledge of Azure Synapse Analytics, particularly Spark pool integration. Solid SQL skills, including query writing, optimization, and performance tuning. Familiarity with data engineering principles including incremental loading, data lake architecture, and Delta Lake. Understanding of data governance and security concepts within a cloud data platform. NICE TO HAVE Experience with SQL Server migration projects, including schema conversion and data movement. Exposure to Terraform for Azure infrastructure provisioning and management. Familiarity with CI/CD practices applied to data engineering workflows. Experience with Delta Sharing or Lakehouse Federation concepts. CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENT Candidates are expected to hold or be actively working toward the Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate certification. This certification validates foundational knowledge across the following domains: Databricks Lakehouse Platform architecture and capabilities ETL and ELT workflows using Spark SQL and PySpark Incremental data processing and structured streaming Production pipeline development and orchestration Data governance and security within the Databricks environment

Support the development and implementation of operational strategies and improvement initiatives. Monitor operational performance indicators and recommend corrective actions when required. 7a409b50ab046dae.description: The Safety Specialist will support the Safety Lead in implementing and maintaining occupational health and safety programs across KAUST facilities, operations, maintenance activities, construction works, and projects . The role will focus on field inspections, audits, risk assessments, incident investigations, safety documentation, contractor engagement, training, corrective action tracking, and compliance with ISO 45001, HSE policies, and applicable regulatory requirements . The position requires a strong field-oriented HSE professional who can identify hazards, evaluate risks, provide practical safety guidance, investigate incidents, and work effectively with facility owners, project teams, contractors, and service providers. Key Responsibilities HSE Program Implementation: Support the Safety Lead in implementing and continuously improving risk-based safety programs across facilities, operations, maintenance, construction, and projects. Safety Inspections & Audits: Conduct risk-based site inspections, safety audits, compliance evaluations, and field verifications to ensure HSE requirements are being followed. Risk Assessment: Perform hazard identification and risk assessments and verify that appropriate control measures are implemented and effective. Safety Documentation Review: Review HSE documents including risk assessments, method statements, safety plans, permits-to-work, lifting plans, excavation plans, confined-space controls, electrical work procedures, and MOC documentation. Incident Investigation: Investigate or support investigations of accidents, injuries, incidents, and near misses, identify root causes, and recommend corrective and preventive actions. 7adfbf032507d005.description: Eram Talent is looking for a detail-oriented and knowledgeable GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) Analyst with COBIT certification to join our team.
